enclosure_144.interpretation: Escaped rays identify open directions from reviewed interior probes. They may be scan holes or legitimate openings and require review. Probe clearance fails when a sampled surface is closer than the declared minimum, which commonly indicates a point inside or immediately against scene geometry.
